rows.en: Kreeeee!!
On hearing Ankh's order, the Taka Candroid flew off at once.
That'll do.
Once it finds out where the Yummy is, it'll come back and tell us.
Peeeep! Peeeep! Kreeeee!!
You found out where the Yummy is?
Peep!!! Kreee!!!
Peep peep peep peep!!
Huh? It's up ahead? Isn't that just a wall?
Hey, go check it out.
{8074} examined the wall.
It was a fake wall, disguised with a hologram!
It looked like they could walk right through to the other side.
Pulling stupid little tricks on us!!
Come on, let's move it!
Peep peep!!
There are Cell Medals lying around...
Did a Yummy fight here...?
Hm...? Wait. Past this door...
Someone's in there... Can you tell?
{8074} peeked inside through the gap in the door.
Mebius was being held captive inside.
Mebius!!
Ultraman Mebius!
Look, it's Mebius!
That's Mebius!
That's Mebius!
Is he one of your buddies?
Yeah. Let's get him out of there, right now!
That's right. Let's rescue him at once!
Yes! We have to help him right away!
Yeah. Let's get him out of there, fast!
That's right. Let's rescue him right away!
(The more fighters we've got, the better...)
Fine. I'll go along with it.
But the door wouldn't open. It seemed to be locked.
Tch! It won't open... The key to this door has to be around here somewhere. Let's look.
What are you doing? Use the key you picked up earlier.
{8074} used the key. The door opened.
Everyone!!
Mebius, are you hurt?
I'm fine, Zero.
Ultraman Mebius, can you move?
I'm all right.
Mebius, you're not hurt, are you?
I'm all right.
Mebius, are you hurt?
I'm all right.
Mebius, are you injured?
I'm all right.
Save the chitchat for later. We're getting out of here!
Right...!
...Hold it. Somebody's coming.
...So? What's today's job again?
Just a nice, easy job: freezing the Ultraman Mebius we captured, you see?
I can handle that all by myself.
Ho ho ho ho. Then I shall let you have the credit this time.
What's wrong?
What's this? Who might you people be...?
Th-this is supposed to be a sealed-off area!
Tough luck. Guess it's not such an easy job after all.
Don't you get smart with me!! Shut your mouth!!! You bastard!!
But hey, this is our chance to score some credit instead, right?
Good point... All right! I'm putting the whole lot of you bastards in cold storage!!
Listen to the sound of yourselves shattering!!
Thank you, you saved me. That was careless of me, as an Ultra Warrior...
You were this close to getting frozen solid. Be grateful.
Ah... What about Hikari!? Is Ultraman Hikari safe!?
Relax. We saved Hikari.
You can rest easy. We rescued Ultraman Hikari.
Don't worry. We rescued Ultraman Hikari.
Relax. We rescued Ultraman Hikari.
It's okay. We rescued Hikari.
...Thank goodness.
Right now, he's maintaining our base for us.
Ultraman Mebius, will you lend us your strength too?
Right now, he's back maintaining the base.
Hey, Mebius. We're both Ultra Warriors, so let's fight together, yeah!?
Right now, he's maintaining our base for us.

notes.note: Taka Candroid cries: 'Peep' for the short cheep (as story_011 0131#0.19), 'Kree' for the shrill hawk screech.
Ankh ordering the player team to inspect the wall.
Narration with no subject in source; 'they' = the player team ({8074}), past tense to match surrounding narration.
'a Yummy' kept indefinite; likely the Siamese Cat Yummy being tracked, but source does not specify.
0.5-0.15, 0.26-0.35, 0.61-0.71: party-dependent variants (Zero/Nu Gundam/OOO/W/Zeta Gundam). OOO's polite -san on Mebius dropped; politeness carried by tone.
Ankh to the party about Mebius (glossary g=m, so 'he').
Snowman Imagin's polite line echoes stock 'easy job' job-ad phrasing; Ankh throws 'easy job' back in 0.48.
Snowman Imagin snaps from polite to crude; kept at full rudeness ('bastard').
Ice Age Dopant addressing the whole party; 'yourselves' plural.

report: 80/80 rows examined. No over-length rows. Party-variant rows rendered per character voice. Taka Candroid cries rendered Peep/Kree. Names/terms not in glossary: none.
